content: Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) is a popular method used to identify the importance of a word in a particular document. TF-IDF transforms text into meaningful numeric representation. This technique is widely used to extract features for Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications BIBREF25 BIBREF26.
